Gain,Ⓒv. i.ⒹlaB 1 A, arj 1 P or c., Ap 5 P, A-samA-sad c.; See Get; ‘g(ain) ground’ upa-ci pass., pravfD 1 A; praruh 1 P; ‘g(ain) over’ sAD c., vaSaM nI 1 P (DanadAnAdinA); anuraMj c., grah 9 U; ‘g(ain) over to oneʼs side’ svapakzaM grah c.; ‘g(ain) a battle’ yudDe jayaM laB; ‘g(ain) the day’ jayaM prAp, vijayin a. BU; ‘g(ain) upon oneʼs steps’ samAsad c.; See Overtake.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹkramaSaH prasfp or pragam 1 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹlABaH, prApti f., PalaM, AyaH, arTaH, utpannaM, PalodayaH, arjanaM.
Ⓝ[Gain]er,Ⓒs.ⒹarjakaH; prAptalABaH; PalaprApakaH.
Ⓝ[Gain]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹPalada; lABajanaka, arTotpAdaka.
Ⓝ[Gainful]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹdakzaM, caturaM, sapAwavaM.

Gainsay,Ⓒv. t.ⒹviruD 7 U; ni-prati-ziD 1 P, pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, apavad 1 U, apalap 1 P, aDarIkf 8 U, nirA-kf, bAD 1 A, niras 4 U.
Ⓝ[Gainsay]er,Ⓒs.ⒹapavAdakaH, nizeDakaH.
Gait,Ⓒs.Ⓓgati f. gamanaM, gataM, cAraH; ‘graceful in g(ait)’ haMsagati, cArugAmin.
